name: 19_open_wooden_drawer
title: Storing and Retrieving Puck From Drawer
summary: A robotic arm opens a wooden desk drawer, places a circular black puck inside, closes the drawer, and later reopens it to retrieve the puck.
robot: one arm with a black parallel gripper
setting: an office desk with a wooden drawer unit

segments.instruction: The robot reaches forward and grasps the black handle of the top drawer. The camera remains fixed.
The robot pulls the top drawer completely open and releases the handle. The camera remains fixed.
The robot moves across to the round black puck on the desk and grasps it. The camera remains fixed.
The robot places the round black puck inside the open drawer and pushes the drawer shut. The camera remains fixed.
segments.memory_event: hide: the round black puck is enclosed inside the shut drawer

segments.instruction: The robot lifts its gripper above the wooden cabinet and rests on the top surface. The camera remains fixed.
The robot moves its arm back toward the center of the workspace and hovers. The camera remains fixed.
The robot grasps the top drawer handle and pulls it open. The camera remains fixed.
segments.memory_event: return: the top drawer opens to reveal the round black puck inside exactly as placed

segments.instruction: The robot reaches into the drawer, picks up what was stored inside, and places it back onto the table. The camera remains fixed.
